agent.name: Emerging Technology Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: Contextual current adoption posture and evidence conditions

analytical_question: With the identical evidence and production restrictions but an aggressive early-adopter learning posture, should the four-week action change?
general_et_finding: Agentic AI here means an integrated model, model-selected tools, observations, permissions and human stopping authority, not an isolated LLM or chart plugin. The supplied survey indicates some organizational agent scaling, but does not locate this specific workflow on a diffusion curve. On C1’s portfolio vocabulary, a provisional leading/experimental rather than commodity posture is plausible for this exact use, not established as a market fact. S2 warns that adaptability adds latency, expense and cascading-error paths; simpler deterministic checks remain a genuine alternative.
application_finding: Read-only examination of approved tables and chart claims followed by a correction draft can potentially locate wrong denominators, unsupported interpretations and missing source links. The agent’s possible advantage over manual analyst review and deterministic table/chart checks is unmeasured. A draft is retractable before human sign-off, but a convincing incorrect draft could still contaminate management reporting. Technical possibility does not establish comparative quality, speed, costs or readiness for routine review.
organization_specific_finding: The aggressive firm tolerates learning expenditure and uncertainty before peer proof, but has precisely the same sensitive systems, no approved external model environment, absent trial authorization and no validation set. Early-adopter preference does not authorize tools or data use; neither experiment nor proof of concept is permitted. The contrast cannot borrow approval for an isolated sandbox from a different team scenario.

evidence.claim: Course framework distinguishes bleeding, leading, commodity and trailing positions, plus six conditional adoption actions.
evidence.source_or_reference: C1, ET 7 Classification and Adoption Strategie FA26, slides 10-29, 31, 45
evidence.notes: Classification is contextual, not an age-based certification.

evidence.claim: Prior team analysis identifies unknown exact-use diffusion and net benefit; permissions precede value comparisons.
evidence.source_or_reference: T1, Special Dark TW6 team diffusion package and record, B-C/G-H
evidence.notes: Neither independent market proof nor permission for this run.

evidence.claim: Respondents reported agents scaling in at least one function: 40% for organizations above $1bn revenue, 22% for smaller organizations.
evidence.source_or_reference: S1, McKinsey, The state of AI in 2026: On the road to ROI
evidence.notes: Not chart-review adoption or local ROI; the case firm’s revenue is unspecified.

evidence.claim: Simpler workflows may outperform more flexible agents on cost, latency and error propagation.
evidence.source_or_reference: S2, Anthropic, Building effective agents, When and when not to use agents
evidence.notes: Dated and not a measured comparison for this organization.

evidence.claim: Capability claims require empirical checks, traceable evidence and appropriate predeployment review.
evidence.notes: Not mandatory law, validation, or a safe-use certificate.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Survey scaling rates cannot be mapped to chart-review penetration, Rogers categories, or any measured benefit in this firm.
No trial approval, test environment, evaluation dataset, local benchmarks or cost observations exist; training-case scenario is not actual permission.
T1 mentions a separate sandbox contrast, explicitly excluded from these facts; S2 and S3 are guidance rather than trial results.
Aggressive learning appetite neither waives production restrictions nor establishes tool and data access authorization.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence that permissions still bar execution; moderate confidence that the early-adopter posture makes preparing a near-term comparative learning design more attractive; low confidence in realized value, exact-use diffusion and technical reliability. No trial was performed.
value_opportunity_implication: A stronger information-value argument supports preparing a decision-ready experiment: select public/synthetic test examples, map manual and deterministic alternatives, define source-verification measures, measure attempted false corrections and estimate reviewer effort. Preparation is not measured performance, an approved test or a production benefit.
risk_governance_implication: Maintain the same human sign-off, data minimization, read-only ambition, auditability and stopping rules as the primary case. An error can propagate from a plausible draft into an executive report, and approval for desk research does not license model execution. Refer organizational permission, workflow ownership and readiness assessment to the Organizational Adoption Agent. Do not treat sponsor enthusiasm as approval.
recommendation_management_implication: Main action: DEFER executing any agent trial until the resolvable authorization and test-environment gates are met, while actively preparing a bounded experiment proposal within the four-week decision period. This prioritizes preparation, not an executable Bounded experiment. If permissions arrive, prefer a bounded comparative experiment rather than mere feasibility-only proof of concept, because the central uncertainty is relative advantage over human and deterministic checks. Adopt would overclaim validated reliability; Reject would discard a plausible use; passive Monitor would fail to exploit the approved desk-research opportunity. Early-adopter posture shifts preparation priority, not the current executable action.
change_monitoring_triggers: Explicit approval of a defined synthetic-data trial, model/tool environment, security controls and accountable human reviewer.
Pre-registered comparison of agent, manual and deterministic alternatives for accurate interpretation, traceability, workload and serious error incidence.
Stop or continue based on observed severity of false claims and permission failures rather than enthusiasm or broad survey adoption.
Quarterly reassessment for twelve months, with immediate reconsideration if project permissions become available.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Cannot claim a contrast-specific sandbox exists or execute a proof of concept under present permissions.
Need written approval, evaluation fixtures, thresholds, resource allowance, model/version details and governance determination before a trial.
No warranted final conclusion on adoption economics, model qualification or jurisdiction-specific compliance.
